text_block_list.text:
I'm going to settle the score from my last 
race, so make sure you don't blink, okay?
choice_data_list:

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'd be lying if I said I didn't feel 
frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
However, if I start saying things like "if 
only I'd done that back then," we'll be 
here until morning.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's why I won't waste time like that. 
What I need is reflection, not regret.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Always keep your gaze up high. Because 
that's a Queen's philosophy!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you. Well, it's time. I'm off.
